title: Prescriptions Store Operations Rule: Will-Call Hold and Return to Stock
content:
A filled prescription under Kestrel Prescriptions waiting in will-call is held from its ready date for the class's will-call hold days.

## Standing rule

1. **Earliest return.** A fill is returned to stock no earlier than the ready date of that fill plus the will-call hold days, counted in calendar days with the ready date as day 0, and only when no pickup entry names it. The ready date comes from the fill ledger; the day the hold ends itself qualifies for the return.
2. **What the return reverses.** The return reverses the fill: a returned refill restores the refills it used; a returned original fill restores none and puts the prescription back in received status; and an insurance-billed fill has its claim reversed under the coverage charter.
3. **Fills out for home delivery.** A fill out for home delivery is not returned to stock while its delivery order is open. Once the delivery charter returns the order to the store, the fill is returned to stock no earlier than the later of the will-call hold's end and the end of that charter's returned-order hold.
4. **No extension.** The hold is never extended at a patient's request; a patient who cannot collect in time has the fill returned to stock and books a new fill when ready.

## Boundary (hypothetical fill, hold of 10 days, ready on day 0, never picked up)

| Day | Return to stock |
|---|---|
| day 9 | not yet |
| day 10 | may be returned |
| day 10, but a pickup entry names the fill | not returned; it has been released |

## Reversal effects

| Fill returned | Refills restored | Prescription status afterwards |
|---|---|---|
| A refill that used 1 refill | 1 | unchanged |
| A refill that used 3 refills | 3 | unchanged |
| The original fill | none | received |

**A delivered order came back to the store on a hypothetical day 12, with the will-call hold ending on day 10 and the returned-order hold ending on day 15.** The fill is returned to stock no earlier than day 15, the later of the two.
